groups.title: On the Record — Counted by Hand

instrumentation.detail: No GA4 property exists for the coin site yet. This is the one unlock for every Reach number: once the property is created under Madison's Google account, the measurement ID is wired into every SG7 page and counting starts that day — not retroactively.
SG7 handles are researched in the social kit but not yet claimed. No accounts means no platform analytics: impressions, video views, shares, and mentions stay dashed until launch.
Accounts are being connected. The feed stays dormant by design: the store is concept-stage and nothing is for sale, so the true units-sold count is zero.
The waitlist runs on an email link today, so joins are counted by hand from the waitlist inbox and logged — the same manual-tally discipline as the Project 2 BANK fulfillment log.
SG7 volume and airdrop wallets can only exist after issuance, which is gated on legal review. These feeds are designed in, and dark until then.

ga.note: No GA4 property exists for the coin site yet. When it is created, these are the headline numbers it reports — the same four Madison reads on the Alice property — pulled weekly into this file.
